fields.summary: Autonomous plan, no owner interview. Read: run 01M7RHR8NEJTECVZ5FYFDJ0H18's status journals one hand-commit intervention for 351cf62f6 'Land and render the run-status flake fix', the conductor's own commit after rhiza land and rhiza render; its message has Change: in a body paragraph and only Co-Authored-By in the trailer block, so no Actor:, Leaf: or Review: trailer. handCommits (internal/api/run_handcommit.go, Decision hand-commit-by-trailer) already treats a commit whose Actor: trailer names the actor of one of the run's sessions as the run's, and the conductor's session record carries its actor (claude-code-9239a99d); so the commit only needs an Actor: trailer. The conduct guide (internal/guide/text/conduct.md, conduct-handback.md) says 'rhiza land, then rhiza render, and commit what they change' with no trailer rule; the commit is written by hand. Ship's own land (internal/api/ship_close.go) already commits .rhiza with 'Change: <cs>' and 'Actor: <actor handle>' trailers, the actor resolved as every write resolves it (shipActorHandle). Plan: rhiza land gains --commit, which lands, renders and commits .rhiza with those trailers, so the conductor's land commit carries its session actor without relying on the agent; the conduct guide tells the conductor to use it and to trailer any other commit; a test shows such a commit is not journalled as an intervention. Leaving handCommits' rule unchanged keeps a person's hand fix with only a Change: trailer counted as an intervention.
